subject: Civic Education
competence: Suggests ways and means to improve income.
unique_learning_outcome: Suggests ways and means to improve income.
Expresses the importance of taking intelligent and society-friendly actions to improve income.
Explains how getting a good income improves living standards.
the_entrance: The importance of earning a good income in today's society.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of earning a good income and its benefits.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes on the importance of earning a good income.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on ways to improve income.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will participate in group discussions and brainstorm ideas.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check for all learning outcomes.
